test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 21 days. With the help of C, they can finish it in 14 days. In how many days will C alone be able to finish the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can do a piece of work in 21 days.

A, B, and C together can finish it in 14 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of A and B together = 1/21

Work rate of A, B, and C together = 1/14

Work rate of C alone = Work rate of A, B, and C together - Work rate of A and B together

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A and B together = 1/21

Work rate of A, B, and C together = 1/14

Work rate of C alone ⇒ 1/14 - 1/21

⇒ (21 - 14) / (14 × 21)

⇒ 7 / 294

⇒ 1 / 42

Time taken by C alone to finish the work = 42 days

**The correct answer is option 3.**
